author: ogurec14
content:
Building an x402-scheme-conformant, ERC-8004-integrated design where payment for an AI inference request only finalizes atomically with a ZK proof (EZKL/Halo2) that the computation matches a pinned circuit. Tested end-to-end on Base Sepolia testnet (real open()/settle() transactions, self-attestation bound to an ERC-8004-style Validation registry). Open reference design: https://ethresear.ch/t/atomic-zk-proof-gated-settlement-for-x402-agent-payments-a-measured-reference-design/25660

Currently on the model-provenance layer: proving a deployed verifying key actually corresponds to published model weights, rather than trusting self-attestation. Published a small, independently-verifiable bundle for a real deployed circuit — reproducible bit-exact against the on-chain VK hash, verified both natively and in Docker: https://github.com/achemperety/exactzk-mnistmlp-provenance-demo

Looking for a small number (3-5) of independent people/orgs willing to be named reproducers for the production deployment — about a 10 minute exercise if anyone's curious. Also happy to talk through the design more broadly if useful to this group.
